name: Jububnan Vanguard
body:
JUBUBNAN VANGUARD
CR 2

XP 600
Jububnan vanguard (tech vanguard) 3
N Medium humanoid (jububnan)
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +1

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 12, flat-footed 13 (+2 Dex, +3 armor)
hp 33 (3d10+9+3)
Fort +6, Ref +5, Will +2
Defensive Abilities mitigate, uncanny dodge

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., swim 30 ft.
Melee entropic strike +3 (1d6+1 B), entropic strike +3 (1d6 B) or entropic strike +5 (1d6+1 B)
Ranged synthetic light crossbow +6 (1d8 P, 19–20/×2, rage incr. 80 ft., AP 1 CW)
Special Attacks entropic strike (1d6), entropic weapon, uncanny speed (Spring Attack)

STATISTICS

Str 12 (+1); Dex 15 (+2); Con 17 (+3); Int 10 (+0); Wis 12 (+1); Cha 8 (–1)
Base Atk +3; CMB +1 (+3 to bull rush); CMD 13 (17 vs. trip, 19 vs. bull rush)
Feats Improved Bull Rush (B), Technologist (B), Two-Weapon Fighting, Weapon Focus (entropic strike)
Skills Acrobatics +8, Climb +7, Intimidate +5, Knowledge (engineering) +8, Perception +7, Survival +7, Swim +9
Languages Common, Jububnan
SQ astonishing balance, entropic pool (max. 3 EP), puff up (3 min./day), vanguard aspects (Momentum: insight), vanguard disciplines (ethereal strike), wanderer’s pluck

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Astonishing Balance (Ex)

A jububnan can move 10 feet instead of 5 feet when taking a crawl action. A jububnan also gains a +4 species bonus to their CMD against bull rush and trip combat maneuvers.

Puff Up (Ex)

As a move action, a jububnan can increase to Large size. This provides the usual benefits and penalties for Large size. The jububnan’s space increases to 10 feet and they gain a reach of 10 feet.

Neither their weight nor their ability scores undergo any change. When puffed up, a jububnan can use either Medium or Large weapons without penalty. If the physical space they’re in can’t accommodate their new size, this ability fails. The jububnan can revert to their normal size at any time as a free action. They can use this ability for a number of minutes per day equal to their character level; these minutes do not need to be consecutive but must be used in 1-minute segments.

When using this ability, the jububnan vanguard’s statistics are: Size Large; AC 14, touch 11, flat-footed 12; Melee entropic strike +2 (1d8+1 B), entropic strike +2 (1d8 B) or entropic strike +4 (1d8+1 B); Ranged synthetic light crossbow +6 (1d8 P); Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.; CMB +2 (+4 to bull rush); CMD 14 (18 vs. trip, 20 vs. bull rush).

Wanderer’s Pluck (Ex)

Jububnans have a tenacious spirit that allows them to thrive while alone. When an effect allows a jububnan to reroll an attack roll, saving throw, ability check, or skill check, they gain a +2 species bonus to that reroll.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary, pair, or knot (3–6)
Treasure NPC gear (freebooter armor, synthetic light crossbow with 10 bolts, other treasure)

Jububnans are a species of Galactic wanderers known for their ability to puff up to double their size. They appear much as humanoid toads with large heads, spindly arms, and but a single large leg. Their underlying color is a dark green, but this is overlaid with bright patterns unique to each individual, which can be of any color and are usually quite vivid.

Jububnans are adventurous and independent. Some of them have congregated on various planets, but many of them travel through the Multiverse. All of them tend to be very independent, and jububnan explorers rarely come across another of their species. Luckily for them, they can reproduce via parthenogenesis, allowing them to spawn dozens of eggs at several times during their short lifespans.
